from math import sqrt

def input_as_type(dtype):
    return [dtype(x) for x in input().split()]

def ceil_divide(a, b):
    return (a + b - 1) // b

def add_modulo(a, b):
    return (a + b) % mod

def multiply_modulo(a, b):
    return (a * b) % mod

n, mod = input_as_type(int)
sequence, total_sum = [0, 1], 1

for i in range(2, n + 1):
    limit = int(sqrt(i)) + 1
    current_sum = total_sum

    for f in range(2, limit):
        current_sum = add_modulo(current_sum, sequence[i // f])

    boundary = i
    for j in range(1, i // limit + 1):
        val = i // (j + 1)
        current_sum = add_modulo(current_sum, multiply_modulo(boundary - val, sequence[j]))
        boundary = val

    total_sum = add_modulo(total_sum, current_sum)
    sequence.append(current_sum)
